primary_sources.claim: Input callbacks are addressed by face/corner; Basic output is unit tangent and sign with simplified bitangent relation, unindexed, and must not be averaged/overwritten through old indices.
primary_sources.observed_content: Read selected callbacks, both-output option, explicit new-index warning and default generation API.
primary_sources.conditions: Basic-only reception for the stated static nondegenerate triangle scope; no full-output magnitude/real-bitangent equivalence or global algorithm proof.

primary_sources.claim: The generator builds internal P/N/UV sharing and later groups; final callbacks retain original face/corner and sign. Successful generation is distinct from receiving a complete output table.
primary_sources.observed_content: Read supported-face count, initial internal welding, final loop and conditional output calls, orientation calculation and subgroup decisions.
primary_sources.conditions: Ordinary nondegenerate triangles only; degenerates/quads have separate paths. Internal welding is not approval of application final vertex sharing. No current native run.

primary_sources.claim: TANGENT is four components; one primitive index selects corresponding elements of all attributes; counts and index type/range/reserved maximum matter. Mikk generation uses coordinates associated with normal texture; equal triangle W is SHOULD and differing W gives undefined tangent space.
primary_sources.observed_content: Read type/finiteness/count/shared-index constraints and exact generation/bitangent wording.
primary_sources.conditions: No extension, morph or skin pipeline verification; logical reconstruction is not completed serialization. Do not turn SHOULD into MUST.

original_method.status: Engineering synthesis derived from source contracts, not an upstream provided reindexing API.
original_method.algorithm: Capture by immutable face/corner; after complete accepted results build a per-primitive key(oldIndex, exact accepted tangent4 representation), copy the full source record and assign corner-to-new index; validate by per-corner expansion before whole-result handoff.
original_method.equality: Explicit bit-pattern policy, finite values required, signed zero may remain split. Unit-length acceptance tolerance is separate from sharing equality. No epsilon welding or cross-platform bitwise guarantee.
original_method.proof_scope: Keeping oldIndex forbids cross-source welding; accepted new tangent data can only refine sharing. Other face-corner or subsequently changed attributes need their own representation/keys.
original_method.cost: At most one logical output record per input corner for this method, subject to count/budget/index-type checks. No measured reduction or performance claim.

historical_materials.input: One mirrored-UV double triangle, six Basic outputs with+X and opposing face signs.
historical_materials.identity: Source manifest six inputs frozen; current archive README change is editorial, not a new execution or acceptance.
historical_materials.limits: Two historical same-input calls, not two geometry cases. Overwrite replay and consumer checks do not add Mikk runs. No original program rerun for this publication.

source_reading: Retained primary bytes rehashed to fixed identities and decisive original paths reread; independent technical review separately verifies source references.
